Container.Name: caas
Container.Overview: HTTP server that wraps the Claude Code CLI for LAN use. Exposes an OpenAI Chat Completions surface at /openai/v1/* and a caas-native session API at /sessions/*. Bootstrap once after first start with: docker exec -it caas claude /login

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Port for the caas HTTP API

Config.Name: Claude State
Config.Description: Persistent storage for OAuth credentials and v2 session state. Bootstrap with: docker exec -it caas claude /login

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: tracing filter (info, debug, trace). Can also be changed at runtime via POST /admin/log-level.

Config.Name: Effort
Config.Description: Default reasoning budget: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Per-request override via X-Caas-Effort header (v1) or effort field (v2).
